title: A Magazine for Young Readers
text:
Lisa reads a magazine every Friday. The magazine is about music, sport and travel. It has bright photos and short articles. Lisa likes the article about a young singer from London.

The magazine costs three pounds. Lisa buys it at the station on her way home. Last month, she wrote a letter to the editor. The editor answered her letter and printed it in the next issue. Lisa was very happy.

questions.text: What does Lisa read every Friday?
How much does the magazine cost?

options: Her letter was printed in the magazine
She won a trip to London

questions.text: What kind of reader is Lisa most likely to be?
options: A person who enjoys reading and sharing opinions
A person who only reads newspapers
A person who works at a station

vocabulary.definition: a publication with articles and photos, printed regularly
a piece of writing in a magazine or newspaper
the person who decides what is printed in a magazine
one copy of a magazine published at one time

paragraph_translations: Lisa lê uma revista toda sexta-feira. A revista é sobre música, esporte e viagens. Ela tem fotos coloridas e artigos curtos. Lisa gosta do artigo sobre uma jovem cantora de Londres.

A revista custa três libras. Lisa a compra na estação no caminho para casa. No mês passado, ela escreveu uma carta para o editor. O editor respondeu à carta dela e a publicou na próxima edição. Lisa ficou muito feliz.
